meta.title: Shaman data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Elemental, Enhancement, Stormcaller and an off-tank proposal
meta.scope: Core rules, every ability a level-60 shaman uses against a raid boss, weapon imbues, totems and their exclusivity, procs, mana economy, the (absent) tank spec and an off-tank model for an attacking dummy, the three talent trees in gunba's order, every shaman build in gs and fs, priority lists, default stats, worked examples and the practice-yard engine gaps. Restoration healing is out of scope; its talents are listed because talent strings need them.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes, class deep dive), or measured on the beta. Most beta measurements were taken at levels 10-30.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where sources disagree (including developer-style bug-tracker replies not flagged as Blizzard). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Engine: wowsims/classic with Forever rules. Shaman tree 16/18/16. No dual wield (engine equipment rule). Overload uses its own client rows; Stormstrike is personal; Windfury Weapon makes two special-table attacks; Weapon Mastery +10% is baseline at 60.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever with the beta client rows (1.60.1.70124). Same tree order and prerequisites as gs, so its strings decode. Legacy code still allows an off-hand weapon and off-hand imbue; Windfury Weapon makes two white swings; Overload is half the parent spell; tests use naked characters (DPS not meaningful).

practiceYardSummary: No dual wield: Enhancement uses a two-hander (or one-hander + shield). Windfury Weapon: 20% per landed melee hit, 1.5 s ICD, two extra attacks with +333 AP (+40% with Elemental Weapons 3/3). Your own Windfury Weapon disables your Windfury Totem benefit.
Stormstrike (Enhancement 16): 125 mana, 8 s cooldown, main-hand weapon hit; your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock within 12 s deals +20% (one charge, personal, not a raid debuff).

Maelstrom Weapon (Enhancement 26): melee hits stack it (5 stacks, 30 s); each stack cuts the next Lightning Bolt's cast time and cost by 20% at 5/5, so 5 stacks = instant and free. Proc rate unknown (both sims: 2 PPM per point).

Lightning Bolt r10: 2.5 s, 190-212 + 0.714 SP, 220 mana. Chain Lightning r4: 2 s, 6 s CD, 119-134 + 0.571. Lava Burst r3 (Elemental 31): 2.5 s, 10 s CD, 192-248 + 0.714 Fire, +20% with your Flame Shock. Elemental Alacrity 3/3: -0.5 s on all three. Elemental Fury 5/5: spell crits 2.0x. Elemental Mastery is removed.
Shocks share a 6 s cooldown. Earth Shock 293-309 + 0.386 (2x threat), Flame Shock 166 + 0.214 then 4 x (44 + 0.1) over 12 s (ticks crit), Frost Shock 278-295 + 0.386.

Totems: 1.0 s GCD (not hasted), buff totems 5 min, one per element. Windfury Totem (246 AP, 20%, 1 extra attack) and Grace of Air (89 Agi) are mutually exclusive even across shamans; Flametongue Totem excludes Windfury Totem. Fire Nova is a spell (10 s CD, 397-443 + 0.214) that needs a live Fire totem.

Mana: gs ranked Elemental spends ~5,550/min and is mana-limited ~42 s per 5 min even with raid Judgement of Wisdom, potions and runes. Water Shield (Restoration 11) only returns mana when you are hit. Offer a 'raid Judgement of Wisdom' toggle.
gs ranks Enhancement 20/31/0 ~810-817 DPS, Elemental 31/7/13 ~490-495, Stormcaller 29/22/0 ~453-461. mythicsim (secondary): Enhancement 691, Elemental 451. No tank shaman spec exists.
meta.wowheadNote: Wowhead Forever prints scaling spells at each rank's maximum scaling level (Lightning Bolt r10 191-213 at 61, Earth Shock 303-318 at 65, Lava Burst r3 203-258 and '+54%' at 68, Windfury Weapon '433 AP' at 68, Rockbiter '686 AP' at 62, Frostbrand 203 at 66). This sheet uses the level-60 values (190-212, 293-309, 192-248 and +20%, 333, 653, 169). Wowhead talent tooltips print stale raw values (Lightning Overload 30%, Anticipation 1%, Improved Stormstrike 20%, Mindfulness 5%, Natural Grace 30%, Elemental Alacrity 0.20 s); this sheet uses gs's tree (client trait curves).

elementalHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Elemental (ours)
elementalHint.source: our synthesis of apl.elementalGs and apl.elementalFs
steps: Before the pull: Searing Totem (and Mana Spring if the raid has none); Lightning Bolt at -2 s or Flame Shock on contact.
Flame Shock whenever it is not ticking.
Lava Burst on cooldown, but only while your Flame Shock is ticking (+20%).
Chain Lightning only on Clearcasting (free).
Lightning Bolt as the filler (2.0 s with Elemental Alacrity 3/3).
Re-drop Searing Totem every 55 s (1.0 s GCD, 170 mana).
Moving: instants only - Flame Shock if it is down, otherwise Earth Shock (shares the shock cooldown).
Potion or rune under ~35% mana; under ~15% mana use Lightning Bolt rank 4-5 as a cheap filler (fs uses rank 4).

enhancementHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Enhancement (ours)
enhancementHint.source: our synthesis of apl.enhancementGs and apl.enhancementFs
steps: Windfury Weapon on the main hand (60 min).
Solo dummy: drop Grace of Air (your Windfury Weapon disables Windfury Totem for you), Strength of Earth r5 and Searing Totem. Party mode: Windfury Totem.
Rage of the Farseer and Blood Fury on cooldown.
Fire Nova whenever Clearcasting is up; otherwise at mana >= 20% (Searing must be alive).
Stormstrike on cooldown; spend its 12 s charge on Earth Shock or a 5-stack Lightning Bolt.
At 5 Maelstrom stacks cast Lightning Bolt at once (instant, free, keeps the swing).
Flame Shock when not ticking; Earth Shock on the shock cooldown otherwise.
Re-drop totems when they expire (Searing every 55 s, the others every 5 min).
Never hardcast Lightning Bolt below 5 stacks: it restarts the swing timer.

stormcallerHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Stormcaller (ours)
steps: Searing Totem, Flame Shock when not ticking, Chain Lightning on Clearcasting, Lightning Bolt otherwise.
Mana runs out first: potion and rune early, low-rank Lightning Bolt below ~15%.

engineGaps.detail: Four element slots, one totem each; placing replaces the slot; a world position (buff radius 30 yd, Searing 20 yd attack range, Magma 8 yd, Fire Nova 10 yd around the Fire totem); durations 5 min / 55 s / 20 s / 12 s; 1.0 s unhasted GCD; a totem bar with remaining time; Totemic Recall (25% refund), Totemic Projection, Call of the Elements (3 s cast, four totems, summed cost).

engineGaps.gap: Totem pulses on their own clocks
engineGaps.detail: Searing attack every 2.2-2.5 s (a projectile), Magma pulse every 2 s, Mana Spring 10 mana per 2 s, Mana Tide 290 per 3 s. Totem damage gets Call of Flame and Elemental Fury but does not trigger Clearcasting or Elemental Devastation; threat goes to the shaman.

Air slot: Windfury Totem and Grace of Air exclude each other even across shamans; Flametongue Totem excludes Windfury Totem; your main-hand Windfury or Flametongue Weapon disables the matching totem for you only (switch off the yard's raid Windfury Totem for an Enhancement player).

Per-weapon temporary enchant (60 min) with its own proc rule: Windfury (20% per landed hit, 1.5 s ICD, two extra attacks with +333/466 AP; toggle white or special), Flametongue (every hit, speed-scaled Fire spell proc on the magic table), Frostbrand (8 PPM), Rockbiter (flat AP and threat).
Earth, Flame and Frost Shock on one 6 s category timer (Reverberation -0.2 s/point), each still checked separately.
One active shield; 3 charges; 3.5 s ICD; triggered by being hit (needs the attacking dummy); Lightning Shield deals non-crit damage to the attacker; Water Shield returns 2% max mana.
A one-charge, 12 s target aura that only your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock consume (+20%).
A PPM stack aura (2 PPM per point on landed melee hits) that scales Lightning Bolt's cast time and cost per stack and is consumed by Lightning Bolt; 5 stacks = instant and free.
Hardcast Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Lava Burst pause melee and restart a full swing at cast end; instant casts keep the swing.
A chance-based free copy with its own damage row, travel time and zero threat that does not consume Clearcasting or the Stormstrike charge.
Clearcasting rolls on cast completion and is not consumed by its own trigger; Elemental Devastation only from direct harmful spell crits (not ticks, procs or totems).
Elemental Fury: shaman Fire/Frost/Nature spells and fire totems crit for 1.5 x (1 + 0.2 x points) bonus (2.0x at 5/5); melee stays 2.0x.
Fire Nova needs a live Fire totem; Lava Burst +20% needs your own Flame Shock on the target.
Average 6% partial resist on non-binary Nature/Fire/Frost vs +3; Earth Shock binary; one gear-hit value feeding both melee (8% cap) and spell (16% cap) tables.
Mana Spring and Mana Tide as direct mana; Water Shield on being hit; a raid Judgement of Wisdom toggle; toggles for Weapon Mastery, Windfury attack type, Searing interval and Water Shield cooldown.

foreverVsClassic: No dual wield, as in Classic (TBC and SoD added it); two-handed axes and maces are a baseline weapon skill.
Lightning Bolt r10 190-212 + 0.714 (was 428-477 + 0.857), 2.5 s cast (3), 220 mana (265); ranks 3-4 raised so every rank is an upgrade.
Earth Shock 293-309 (517-545), Flame Shock 166 + 176 over 12 s (292 + 320), Frost Shock 278-295 (492-520); Lightning Shield orbs 178 (198); periodic ticks can crit.

New: Lava Burst (Elemental 31), Lightning Overload, Earthbound, Maelstrom Weapon, Rage of the Farseer, Mental Dexterity, Mental Quickness, Improved Stormstrike, Shamanistic Focus (flat -45%), Mindfulness, Water Shield, Riptide, Totemic Recall, Totemic Projection, Call of the Elements/Ancestors/Spirits.
Removed: Elemental Mastery, Fire Nova Totem (now the Fire Nova spell, 10 s CD, around your Fire totem), Tranquil Air Totem, Shield Specialization, Nature's Guidance, Totemic Mastery.
Stormstrike: 8 s (20), 125 mana, personal +20% to your next LB/CL/ES (was +20% Nature damage taken for two hits, a raid debuff).

Totems: 1.0 s GCD (1.5), buff totems 5 min (1-2 min); Windfury Totem is a party buff (246 AP, one extra attack); Grace of Air 89, Strength of Earth 53; Searing coefficient 0.017; Magma 73; resistance totems raid-wide; Windfury, Grace of Air and Flametongue Totem exclusivity.
Imbues last 60 min (5) and coexist with stones and oils; Windfury Weapon has a 1.5 s proc ICD and disables your own Windfury Totem benefit.

Flurry 25% max (30%); Toughness and Ancestral Knowledge are percentages; Anticipation doubled; Thundering Strikes covers spells; Tidal Focus gives hit; Elemental Devastation row 2; Call of Thunder the 16-point talent; Mana Tide 16 points; Earth's Grasp moved to Enhancement.
